title: 第264章 谁才是鱼第263章 终于让步
content_zh:
“但是思雨想了个好主意，那就是用这一个亿去杏花村投资，投资是做生意，说不定还能反过来赚一大笔呢，这样一来你家里那些叔叔伯伯就没有理由反对了，杏花村的村长为了争取这个投资机会，主动跑去说服了那个赵老头，逼他让步。”
“然后你就从警务署里出来了，现在明白了吧？你这次能安然无恙的脱罪，多亏了思雨，你回去以后可要好好感谢人家！”
钱博中于是就对钱思雨说道：“谢谢你嗷，老妹。”
“一句谢谢就完事了？”钱思雨不悦的说道。
“那你还想让我怎么样，难道要我这个老哥跪下来给你磕头不成？”钱博中说道。
“这样也不是不行。”钱思雨说道。
钱万贯连忙说道：“好了好了你们兄妹两个就别窝里斗了，你们赵叔还在一旁看着呢，丢不丢人啊？”
钱博中没有再看钱思雨，转过头看向钱万贯说道：“爸，既然我已经从警务署里出来了，那还有什么好怕的？这一个亿的投资计划直接取消了，咱们不在杏花村投资了。”
钱思雨眉头紧皱，恼火的说道：“不行，我不同意，我都已经和杏花村的村长苏玉洁谈好了，现在取消投资计划那我的脸面往哪里搁？”
“一个亿重要还是你的脸面重要？咱家虽然有钱，但也不能这样子霍霍。”钱博中振振有词。
“我拿钱投资做生意，总比你花天酒地玩女人强的多。”钱思雨反唇相讥。
听到这话，钱博中勃然大怒。
钱万贯立刻说道：“行了博中，你不要再说了，那个苏玉洁可不是一个普普通通的农村村长，她身后站着桃花县女县首苏淑珍呢！而且苏淑珍也不是一个普普通通的县城县首，这个女人能量大的很，绝对不能小觑了她。”
“既然现在思雨已经和杏花村的那个苏村长谈好了，那就这么办，投资一个亿在杏花村里搞农家乐。而且思雨说了，杏花村的环境确实很不错，运营得当，这一个亿的投资不仅不会打水漂，反而还能大赚一笔。这样一来，那就是好事成双，双喜临门了！”
钱博中嘟哝道：“我不觉得思雨这个投资计划能赚到钱，十有八九……”
“这就轮不到你操心了，你快点回家玩你的那些女人去吧，生意上的事情轮不到你管。”钱思雨毫不客气的说道。
钱博中脸色阴沉，右手都攥成拳头了。
看来钱博中和钱思雨这对兄妹的关系，并不和睦。
天渐渐黑了。
赵富贵早早的在家里，和陈慧兰陈雪涵一起吃过晚饭，便开车出门。

赵富贵这次来桃花县，当然是要帮王秀芹和王有才，弄回那十万块钱。
对这件事，赵富贵非常有信心，而且根本不怕失败。
就算真的找不到那群搞仙人跳的王八蛋，要不回那十万块钱，也没关系。
赵富贵自己拿十万块钱给王秀芹王有才也是一样的。
现在王秀芹已经是赵富贵的女人了，他当然不介意在这个女人身上多花点钱。
content_en:
"But Siyu came up with a good idea, which is to use the 100 million to invest in Xinghua Village. The investment is doing business, and maybe you can make a lot of money in return. In this way, your uncles and uncles at home will have no reason to object. In order to win this investment opportunity, the village chief of Xinghua Village took the initiative to persuade the old man Zhao and force him to give in."
"Then you came out of the police station. Do you understand now? You were able to get away with it safely this time, thanks to Siyu. You have to thank them when you go back!"
Qian Bozhong then said to Qian Siyu: "Thank you, sister."
"Is that all you need to say thank you?" Qian Siyu said unhappily.
"Then what else do you want me to do? Do you want me, this old man, to kneel down and kowtow to you?" Qian Bozhong said.
"This is not impossible." Qian Siyu said.
Qian Wanguan said quickly: "Okay, okay, you two brothers and sisters, please stop fighting in the nest. Your Uncle Zhao is still watching from the sidelines. Isn't it embarrassing?"
Qian Bozhong did not look at Qian Siyu anymore. He turned to Qian Wanguan and said, "Dad, since I have come out of the police station, what else do I have to be afraid of? This 100 million investment plan has been canceled directly. We will no longer invest in Xinghua Village."
Qian Siyu frowned and said angrily: "No, I don't agree. I have already negotiated with Su Yujie, the head of Xinghua Village. If the investment plan is canceled now, where will my face go?"
"Is it more important to have 100 million or your face? Although our family is rich, we can't live like this." Qian Bozhong said plausibly.
"It's better for me to invest my money in business than for you to spend your days and nights playing with women." Qian Siyu retorted.
Hearing this, Qian Bozhong became furious.
Qian Wagguan immediately said: "Okay, Bo Zhong, please stop talking. That Su Yujie is not an ordinary rural village chief. Behind her stands Su Shuzhen, the female county chief of Taohua County! And Su Shuzhen is not an ordinary county chief. This woman is very powerful. You must not underestimate her."
"Now that Siyu has reached an agreement with the village chief Su of Xinghua Village, let's do this. Invest 100 million to build agritainment in Xinghua Village. And Siyu said that the environment of Xinghua Village is indeed very good, and if it is properly run, this 100 million investment will not only not be wasted, but will also make a lot of money. In this way, good things will come in pairs, and double happiness will come!"
Qian Bozhong muttered: "I don't think Siyu's investment plan can make any money, nine times out of ten..."
"It's not your turn to worry about it now. Go home and play with your women. It's not your turn to worry about business matters." Qian Siyu said unceremoniously.
Qian Bozhong's face was gloomy, and his right hand was clenched into a fist.
It seems that the relationship between brother and sister Qian Bozhong and Qian Siyu is not harmonious.
It was getting dark.
Zhao Fugui was at home early, had dinner with Chen Huilan and Chen Xuehan, and then drove out.
Zhao Fugui came to Taohua County this time, of course, to help Wang Xiuqin and Wang Youcai get back the 100,000 yuan.
Zhao Fugui was very confident in this matter and was not afraid of failure at all.
Even if you really can't find those bastards who are doing the fairy dance, it doesn't matter if you don't get back the 100,000 yuan.
The same goes for Zhao Fugui himself giving 100,000 yuan to Wang Xiuqin and Wang Youcai.
Now that Wang Xiuqin is Zhao Fugui's woman, he certainly doesn't mind spending more money on this woman.
